commits.subject: fix(health/contest_state): level-aware staleness; stop nightly false-CRITICAL
commits.body:
End-of-day health runs after the scheduler settles day D (latest_resolved -> D)
but before the next-morning fetch advances the contest source_date to D, so the
expected one-day overnight lag fired a CRITICAL "STALE" DM most nights — alert
fatigue that could mask a genuine stale event. Make the check gap-aware:
  - gap == 1 (expected overnight)            -> INFO (logged, never DM'd)
  - gap  > 1 (genuine staleness/freeze class)-> CRITICAL
  - no source_date (unverifiable)            -> CRITICAL
  - future source_date (corrupt/fat-fingered)-> CRITICAL
Pick-path freshness stays strict (any gap >= 1 disables doubles). Daytime fetch
failures remain owned by the throttled _contest_fetch_alert DM, so this check
need not duplicate that detection.
